method.both: Require both points on the same paragraph
method.development: Only earlier source-disjoint v292 development originals, no mixed positives or new control responses
method.display: One unique top qualifying paragraph, covering the paragraph-only classifier input. Retain existing six source-ordered context cap for baselines.
method.isolated: Score entire paragraph as one classifier input with complete 512-token overflow coverage. Eligible if two adjacent paragraphs and all have at least 20 words.
method.metric: At least 0.30 non-whitespace character IoU. Flag and overlap also counted. Local study only.
method.operating_point: Strictly above second-largest file maximum among all 13 development originals for each of the two scores
method.two_sided: Clipped natural log-odds of the paragraph minus the larger of its neighbors, with epsilon 1e-6

method.eligibility: Actual EOS; existing v273 single paragraph, normalized word length, no wrapper/links/source-copy checks; exact human flanks and Unicode bounds; no cross-source normalized 12-token overlap

scope: Constructed science-explainer rewrites with matched publisher controls. New source IDs are independent of the checked project inventories; pretraining exposure unknown.

policy.choice: In response order, try the first paragraph block admissible under the original gates. Remove one standalone trailing-colon wrapper heading. For overlong plain content, try the longest complete sentence prefix at or below the original word bound. No selection from detector responses.
policy.goal: Separate deterministic selection of complete sentences when a generator responds with formatting or excessive words
policy.inputs: All exact terminal generation outputs. Retain primary admitted cases. Consider only naturally ended outputs rejected for wrapper/multiple paragraphs or length; preserve source-copy exclusions.
policy.quality: Reapply the same source-copy, length, contact, wrapper, source overlaps, exact flanks and Unicode positions. Ignore complete blocks with a wrapper, contact or list-like syntax.
policy.scoring: Same frozen current, strict, isolated, two-sided, and corroborated points. Score recovered cases only, and combine with exact unchanged primary results.

source_attribution: Publisher works used as excerpts. Copyedits, same-work substitutions, and model-generated paragraph replacements were produced for evaluation. The aggregate includes no article excerpts, rewrites or customer data.
